structured_output.what_is_happening: "🐻Bear" is a PumpSwap pair created directly (not a pump.fun graduate: the pump.fun API returns 404 and migrated_unix=0) about 40 minutes before detection. It has no socials, website or description. Liquidity ($61k) is larger than market cap ($45k), which means the deployer seeded the pool with SOL, and that LP is 0% locked or burned (RugCheck flags it as danger). At least 10 other tokens with the same "🐻Bear" symbol were created from about 06:46 UTC today, one every 20-60 minutes. All of them now show $0 liquidity. The latest sibling (vtJt…, created about 34 minutes before this one) had nearly the same activity profile: about $219k volume, +143%, 2,983 buys to 1,822 sells. Its liquidity is now fully removed. The flow on this token looks manufactured. GeckoTerminal shows 1,114 unique buyers but only 107 unique sellers, who account for 2,390 sells. GMGN flags 26 bundler wallets, and only about 92 unique buyers were active in the last 5 minutes. Price is flat near its all-time high. This matches a serial rug farm: deploy, bot the volume, pull the LP.
